Meet The Baker

Imelda

The hands, the heart, and the whisk behind every bake at Melda's Treats. Imelda started this bakery in Bonaberi with one goal: to make sure every cake, pastry, and parfait leaving her kitchen feels as good as it tastes.

From first birthdays to milestone celebrations, she designs and bakes every order personally — made with love, every single time.
